ns.title: NetShare Proxy · Root-free Network & VPN Sharing Relay
ns.desc: NetShare Proxy: a root-free Android network & VPN sharing relay with HTTP/SOCKS5 dual protocol, VPN-relay/direct dual-track routing, QR onboarding and connection control. Privacy-first, no account, no tracking.
ns.sub: Root-free Android network & VPN sharing relay
ns.lead: On Android devices without root, securely share your phone's network (cellular, Wi-Fi, or an encrypted VPN link) with nearby computers, tablets, and game consoles. Low-friction one-tap start/stop, professional-grade network control.
ns.features.heading: Core capabilities
ns.feat.dual.d: HTTP/HTTPS and SOCKS5 listen simultaneously, covering different client needs.
ns.feat.route.d: VPN relay / direct egress, hot-switchable at runtime, auto-resets sockets without interruption.
ns.feat.iface.d: Automatically detects hotspot, USB RNDIS, and Wi-Fi Direct, and binds the primary interface.
ns.feat.onboard.d: One-tap setup via QR code / PAC / WPAD, with illustrated guides for five platforms.
ns.feat.control.d: Device discovery, real-time rate limiting, temporary blocking, and username/password authentication.
ns.feat.keepalive.d: A persistent foreground-service notification reduces the chance of aggressive ROMs killing the process.
ns.audience.heading: Who it's for
ns.audience.1: Business travel / mobile work: only the phone has network, and you need to temporarily share it with a laptop.
ns.audience.2: You want all downstream devices to reuse the encrypted VPN link already connected on the phone.
ns.audience.3: Geeks and power users who need fine-grained network control (rate limiting, authentication, blocking).
ns.privacy.heading: Privacy policy
ns.privacy.nodata.p: NetShare Proxy follows a "privacy-first, offline-first" design philosophy:
ns.privacy.point.1: The app does not collect, store, or upload any personally identifiable information.
ns.privacy.point.2: The app requires no account and contains no account system.
ns.privacy.point.3: The app makes no data-reporting or telemetry requests to any server.
ns.privacy.point.4: All network configuration, device lists, and statistics are stored locally on the device only and are cleared on uninstall.
ns.privacy.point.5: Running as a local network relay, forwarded traffic is neither logged nor analyzed.
ns.privacy.perm.1: Network access / foreground service: used to run the local HTTP/SOCKS5 proxy and keep the service resident.
ns.privacy.perm.2: Notifications: used to show the persistent foreground notification so you can switch modes or stop the service at any time.
ns.privacy.ads.p: If a future version introduces advertising, the ad partners will be declared via app-ads.txt, and the corresponding data-processing details will be updated on this page at that time. The current version contains no third-party ad SDK.
